- Dark brown/black mottling pattern on seed coat

- Normal seed shape preserved

The reference shows Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus manifests as leaf mottling and seed discoloration. The top-right panel shows seeds with dark blotchy discoloration inside pods - very consistent with the test image showing dark mottling radiating from the hilum.

The dark brown/black mottled seed coat pattern matches Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus, where hilum pigment diffusion causes mottling (dark hilum = dark discoloration). Purple_Seed_Stain would be pink/purple, not dark brown/black.
